response.rationale: The item is not a final-sale item and was delivered 37 days ago, exceeding the 30-day standard return window (RET-008). Although the customer describes the lamp as arriving in pieces, the facts explicitly state defective == false, so the defective-item exception (RET-020) does not apply. No goodwill grant or fraud hold is present, and the category is home (not electronics), so no higher-priority rule applies. The out-of-window ineligibility controls.
